name: Melody
storyline: Melody envisions the universe as being a musical construct. The underlying fabric is the Harmony. Harmony is balance. It is symmetry. It is emptiness. Harmony gave rise to the Melody. The universal Melody is asymmetry. It is material. It is creation. All things that we can see and touch and experience are the universe's Melody. But a dissonance has taken hold of the Melody. The universe has become detuned and corrupt. You must conduct the notes of the Melody to resolve them and fold them back into the Harmony so that creation can begin anew.
summary: Melody is a free browser-first zero-gravity physics puzzle game. As a Zen experience, Melody is designed to reward you for remaining calm and centered and will punish you if you lose your temper. Guide a rubbery player ball through kinetic arenas and intricate puzzles. Push matching colors together to clear them while preventing mismatched collisions from multiplying the board. Momentum, powerups, intricate mechanics and musical feedback turn controlled chaos into harmony. Melody features an in browser level editor to allow players to design and publish their own community levels using the exact same tools that we created for the official levels!
